rows.derivation: Pins the documented choice (CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-26: per-file encoding by BOM, no control functions, BOM not source text). UTF-8 no-BOM main COPYs UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE and UTF-32BE (+BOM) library texts, each declaring one item; each DISPLAY shows that item's VALUE (UTF-16-LE / UTF-16-BE / UTF-32-BE) then the main file's own UTF-8 item. Any other decoding yields NUL-interleaved text that does not compile.

rows.derivation: COLLATING SEQUENCE OF PRIME-CODE IS REV where PRIME-CODE is no data-name anywhere (so not data-name-1) and no key clause declares a record-key-name of that spelling -> the record-key-name-1 reading violates SR5 -> reject at 2002/2014/2023 with COBOLNET1582 (DIAGNOSTICS.md: key-level name not a declared RECORD/ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, §12.4.5.7.3 SR3-SR8). Control variant 'OF KF-ALT' compiles.
citations: cite.py --check 12.4.5.7.3 'Record-key-name-1 shall be a name specified as a record-key-name in an ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause or in a RECORD KEY clause in the file control entry' -> OK §12.4.5.7.3 5)
cite.py --check 12.4.5.7.3 'Data-name-1 shall be a name specified as the data-name in an ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause' -> OK §12.4.5.7.3 4)
rows.notes: Since record-key-name declaration (SOURCE IS) is Not claimed (COBOLNET1954), an undeclared word in the Format-2 slot is the only way to exercise the SR5 arm; the unit test FileCollatingSequenceSpecTests.KeyLevel_NameThatIsNotAKey_Diagnosed uses a non-key DATA-NAME (SR4 arm). Not reject-at 85: the clause is a 2002 introduction.

rows.derivation: COLLATING SEQUENCE OF KF-KEY(1) IS REV (KF-KEY the prime key; the unsubscripted variant compiles at 2002/2014/2023) violates SR6 -> rejected at every edition having the clause. .err = "COBOL0312: unexpected '('".
citations: cite.py --check 12.4.5.7.3 'Data-name-1 and record-key-name-1 shall not be subscripted' -> OK §12.4.5.7.3 6)
cite.py --check 12.4.5.12.3 'Data-name-1 and data-name-2 shall not be subject to any OCCURS clauses' -> OK §12.4.5.12.3 1)
rows.notes: CAVEAT for the director: the diagnostic is the generic parse error COBOL0312 (unexpected token in FILE-CONTROL), not a rule-named COBOLNET code - the grammar simply has no subscript position in Format 2, which is SR6's content. Corpus precedent exists for parse-code negatives (e.g. pb332-*.err = COBOL0001). A record key can never be in a table (§12.4.5.12.3 SR1), so no subscriptable key exists to isolate SR6 further.

rows.derivation: PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV (Z..A) is in force (it governs relations/condition-names/CONTROL and sort-merge keys only, §12.3.6.4 GR11/GR13). File KF has only a key-level clause (OF KF-KEY IS REV), no alphabet-name-1; file NF has no clause. Records AM, MZ, ZA. KF by prime (REV, GR6) -> 'Z/A M/Z A/M'; KF by alternate via START >= SPACE (native, GR4) -> 'Z/A A/M M/Z'; NF by prime (native, GR4) -> 'A/M M/Z Z/A'.

rows.derivation: Each item followed by COLUMN PLUS 1 '|' (GR8/GR9: '|' lands one column past the prior item's rightmost column = printable-size). Line 2: PIC 9(3)V99=12.34 -> '01234' (5, V prints none); PIC S999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE=-12 -> '-012' (4); PIC -ZZ9.99=-12.34 -> '- 12.34' (7); VALUE "ABC" no PICTURE -> 'ABC' (3) => '01234|-012|- 12.34|ABC|'. Line 3: PIC X(4) VALUE "PQ" -> size 4 from the PICTURE not 2 from the literal => 'PQ  |'.
